passages.text: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken; it has swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will be filled,’ therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, O Tyre, I am against you, and I will raise up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
This happened in the twelfth year.
It was the first day of the month.
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
God said, “Tyre spoke against Jerusalem.”
Tyre said, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken.’
Tyre said, ‘The gate has swung open to me.’
Tyre said, ‘Jerusalem lies in ruins.’
Tyre said, ‘Now I will be filled with wealth.’
Therefore, the Lord GOD says this.
God says, ‘O Tyre, I am against you.’
God says, ‘I will bring many nations against you.’
These nations will come like the sea brings its waves.’
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁר־ אָ֨מְרָה צֹּ֤ר עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ הֶאָ֔ח נִשְׁבְּרָ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָעַמִּ֖ים נָסֵ֣בָּה אֵלָ֑י אִמָּלְאָ֖ה הָחֳרָֽבָה׃ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ צֹ֑ר וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים כְּהַעֲל֥וֹת הַיָּ֖ם לְגַלָּֽיו׃

passages.text: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock.
passages.sermon:
The Lord spoke about Tyre.
He said that people will destroy the walls of Tyre.
They will tear down her towers.
The Lord will remove all her soil.
He will make Tyre a bare rock.
passages.original: וְשִׁחֲת֞וּ חֹמ֣וֹת צֹ֗ר וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ מִגְדָּלֶ֔יהָ וְסִֽחֵיתִ֥י עֲפָרָ֖הּ מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְנָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֖הּ לִצְחִ֥יחַ סָֽלַע׃

passages.text: She will become a place to spread nets in the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations, and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to the prophet Ezekiel.
The Lord GOD is powerful and rules over all nations.
The Lord GOD said these words about Tyre.
Tyre will become a bare rock in the sea.
People will spread fishing nets there.
The Lord GOD has spoken this.
Tyre will become plunder for many nations.
The villages of Tyre on the mainland will be killed by the sword.
People will know that the Lord is God.
passages.original: מִשְׁטַ֨ח חֲרָמִ֤ים תִּֽהְיֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיָּ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְבַ֖ז לַגּוֹיִֽם׃ וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּחֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with cavalry and a great company of troops.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the highest authority.
He says this message.
He will act against Tyre.
Tyre is a powerful city.
He will bring Nebuchadnezzar against Tyre.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar is called king of kings.
He will come from the north.
He will come with horses.
He will come with chariots.
He will come with cavalry.
He will come with a large army.
He will come with many people.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל־ צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל מִצָּפ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים בְּס֛וּס וּבְרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים וְקָהָ֥ל וְעַם־ רָֽב׃

passages.text: He will slaughter the villages of your mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp to your walls, and raise his shields against you.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
He is a powerful king.
He will attack Tyre.
He will kill the villages on your mainland with the sword.
He will build siege works against you.
He will pile up a ramp against your walls.
He will set up his shields against you.
passages.original: בְּנוֹתַ֥יִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֑ג וְנָתַ֨ן עָלַ֜יִךְ דָּיֵ֗ק וְשָׁפַ֤ךְ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ סֹֽלְלָ֔ה וְהֵקִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִךְ צִנָּֽה׃

passages.text: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks about Tyre.
Nebuchadnezzar is king of Babylon.
He is a powerful king.
He will attack Tyre.
He will use battering rams against your walls.
He will strike your walls with these rams.
He will use his axes to tear down your towers.
Your towers will fall by his weapons.
passages.original: וּמְחִ֣י קָֽבָלּ֔וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּחֹֽמוֹתָ֑יִךְ וּמִ֨גְדְּלֹתַ֔יִךְ יִתֹּ֖ץ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: His multitude of horses will cover you in their dust. When he enters your gates as an army entering a breached city, your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry, wagons, and chariots.
passages.sermon:
An enemy will attack you.
He will come with many horses.
The dust from his horses will cover you.
He will bring a great army.
The army will have cavalry, wagons, and chariots.
The noise from the cavalry, wagons, and chariots will be very loud.
Your walls will shake from the noise.
He will enter your gates.
He will come in like an army entering a city that has been broken open.
passages.original: מִשִּׁפְעַ֥ת סוּסָ֖יו יְכַסֵּ֣ךְ אֲבָקָ֑ם מִקּוֹל֩ פָּרַ֨שׁ וְגַלְגַּ֜ל וָרֶ֗כֶב תִּרְעַ֙שְׁנָה֙ חֽוֹמוֹתַ֔יִךְ בְּבֹאוֹ֙ בִּשְׁעָרַ֔יִךְ כִּמְבוֹאֵ֖י עִ֥יר מְבֻקָּעָֽה׃

passages.text: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will slaughter your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.
passages.sermon:
A powerful enemy will attack you.
His horses will run through your city.
Their hooves will trample all your streets.
He will kill your people with the sword.
Your strong pillars will fall down to the ground.
passages.original: בְּפַרְס֣וֹת סוּסָ֔יו יִרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־ כָּל־ חֽוּצוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַמֵּךְ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֔ג וּמַצְּב֥וֹת עֻזֵּ֖ךְ לָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּרֵֽד׃

passages.text: They will plunder your wealth and pillage your merchandise. They will demolish your walls, tear down your beautiful homes, and throw your stones and timber and soil into the water.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Tyre.
Enemies will take your wealth.
They will steal your merchandise.
They will destroy your walls.
They will tear down your beautiful homes.
They will throw your stones into the water.
They will throw your timber into the water.
They will throw your soil into the water.
passages.original: וְשָׁלְל֣וּ חֵילֵ֗ךְ וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ רְכֻלָּתֵ֔ךְ וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ חוֹמוֹתַ֔יִךְ וּבָתֵּ֥י חֶמְדָּתֵ֖ךְ יִתֹּ֑צוּ וַאֲבָנַ֤יִךְ וְעֵצַ֙יִךְ֙ וַֽעֲפָרֵ֔ךְ בְּת֥וֹךְ מַ֖יִם יָשִֽׂימוּ׃

passages.text: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
passages.sermon: God speaks to Tyre.\r\nGod will stop the sound of your songs.\r\nNo one will hear the music of your lyres again.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁירָ֑יִךְ וְק֣וֹל כִּנּוֹרַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread the fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Tyre.
I am the LORD.
I will make you, Tyre, like a bare rock.
You will become a place where people spread fishing nets.
No one will rebuild you.
I, the LORD, have spoken this.
The Lord GOD declares it.
passages.original: וּנְתַתִּ֞יךְ לִצְחִ֣יחַ סֶ֗לַע מִשְׁטַ֤ח חֲרָמִים֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan at the slaughter in your midst?
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Tyre.
He is the Lord.
He has all power.
He says these words to Tyre.
Tyre is a city by the sea.
The Lord asks a question.
He says, “Will not the coastlands shake?”
The coastlands are the lands by the sea.
They will shake when they hear the sound of your fall.
Your fall will be great.
There will be groaning from the wounded people.
There will be killing in your city.
The islands will tremble because of your downfall.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְצ֑וֹר הֲלֹ֣א׀ מִקּ֣וֹל מַפַּלְתֵּ֗ךְ בֶּאֱנֹ֨ק חָלָ֜ל בֵּהָ֤רֵֽג הֶ֙רֶג֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ הָאִיִּֽים׃

passages.text: All the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled over you.
passages.sermon:
The princes of the sea are rulers over the coastal nations.
All the princes of the sea will leave their thrones.
They will take off their robes.
They will remove their embroidered garments.
They will put on clothes of terror.
They will sit on the ground.
They will tremble again and again.
They will be appalled because of you.
passages.original: וְֽיָרְד֞וּ מֵעַ֣ל כִּסְאוֹתָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהֵסִ֙ירוּ֙ אֶת־ מְעִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתָ֖ם יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ חֲרָד֤וֹת׀ יִלְבָּ֙שׁוּ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְחָֽרְדוּ֙ לִרְגָעִ֔ים וְשָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: Then they will lament for you, saying, “How you have perished, O city of renown inhabited by seafaring men— she who was powerful on the sea, along with her people, who imposed terror on all peoples!
passages.sermon:
The princes of the sea will mourn for you.
They will sing a lament over you.
They will say to you, “How you have perished!”
You were a city known among the nations.
You were inhabited by people who sailed the seas.
You were a famous city.
You were strong on the sea.
Your people were strong with you.
You and your people brought fear to everyone who lived there.
passages.original: וְנָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ קִינָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִיַּמִּ֑ים הָעִ֣יר הַהֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַיָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְיֹשְׁבֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם לְכָל־ יוֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are dismayed by your demise.” ’
passages.sermon:
The coastlands are far away from you.
The coastlands see your downfall.
The coastlands tremble with fear on that day.
The islands are in the sea.
The islands hear about your demise.
The islands are dismayed because of you.
passages.original: עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽאִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ךְ וְנִבְהֲל֛וּ הָאִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיָּ֖ם מִצֵּאתֵֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city like other deserted cities, and when I raise up the deep against you so that the mighty waters cover you, then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins, with those who descend to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks these words.
He says this to Tyre, a city known for its beauty and trade.
He will make Tyre a desolate city.
Tyre will become like other cities that no one lives in.
He will bring up the deep waters against Tyre.
The mighty waters will cover Tyre.
He will bring Tyre down with those who go to the Pit.
These are the people of long ago.
He will make Tyre live in the earth below.
Tyre will be like ancient ruins.
Tyre will be with those who go down to the Pit.
No one will live in Tyre again.
Tyre will not have splendor in the land of the living.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֹתָךְ֙ עִ֣יר נֶחֱרֶ֔בֶת כֶּעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ נוֹשָׁ֑בוּ בְּהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־ תְּה֔וֹם וְכִסּ֖וּךְ הַמַּ֥יִם הָרַבִּֽים׃ וְהוֹרַדְתִּיךְ֩ אֶת־ י֨וֹרְדֵי ב֜וֹר אֶל־ עַ֣ם עוֹלָ֗ם וְ֠הוֹשַׁבְתִּיךְ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֜וֹת כָּחֳרָב֤וֹת מֵֽעוֹלָם֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר לְמַ֖עַן לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֑בִי וְנָתַתִּ֥י צְבִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: I will make you an object of horror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but will never be found,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says this to Tyre.
I will make you an object of horror.
You will no longer exist.
People will look for you.
They will not find you again.
This will last forever.
The Lord GOD has declared it.
passages.original: בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖ךְ וְאֵינֵ֑ךְ וּֽתְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְלֹֽא־ תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃ס
